skill.name: emaildesignskill
skill.description: Guides AI agents through responsive email audits, component planning, dark-mode QA, accessibility checks, and design-to-email handoff.
skill.summary: Plan, review, and improve responsive email designs with structured QA checks.
skill.author: Sequenzy

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual review found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable behavior in the skill content.

content.value_statement: Responsive email work often fails across clients, devices, and dark mode. This skill guides structured audits, module planning, and handoff checks for reliable email production.
actual_capabilities: Reviews email hierarchy, CTA order, scannability, and fallback content.
Checks responsive structure, column collapse, image ratios, and mobile tap targets.
Identifies client risks for Outlook, Gmail clipping, unsupported CSS, and image blocking.
Evaluates dark-mode behavior, contrast, alt text, and link affordance.
Produces template audits, module specs, QA tables, and design handoff checklists.
limitations: Does not replace real rendering tests in Litmus, Email on Acid, or target inboxes.
Requires supplied HTML, screenshots, components, or design details for precise review.
Does not send email or change live email systems without explicit approval.
Provides production guidance, not legal or deliverability compliance certification.

use_cases.title: Template QA Before Launch
use_cases.description: Review HTML or ESP templates for mobile collapse, dark-mode contrast, image blocking, and CTA clarity before a campaign ships.

use_cases.title: Reusable Module Planning
use_cases.description: Define module constraints, content limits, and fallback behavior for a scalable email design system.

use_cases.title: Developer Handoff Review
use_cases.description: Translate a Figma or React Email concept into implementation notes with client risks and accessibility checks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit One Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $emaildesignskill to audit this email template for hierarchy, mobile behavior, dark mode, accessibility, and client rendering risks. Return prioritized fixes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one template before QA.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Reusable Modules
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $emaildesignskill to define reusable email modules for this campaign series. Include content limits, layout constraints, fallback behavior, and QA notes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for an email design system.

prompt_templates.title: Review Design Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $emaildesignskill to review this design handoff for build readiness. Flag missing specs, accessibility risks, dark-mode issues, and client-specific concerns.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate handoff review from design to development.

prompt_templates.title: Build QA Risk Matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $emaildesignskill to create a QA risk matrix for this email program. Cover target clients, responsive states, dark mode, content extremes, and approval gates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced QA planning for a production email workflow.

output_examples.input: A marketer provides a campaign screenshot and asks why the mobile version feels weak.
output_examples.output: The audit identifies weak preview text, a low-contrast CTA in dark mode, and a two-column collapse risk. It recommends a text-based button, fallback colors, and an image-blocking check.

output_examples.input: A design lead asks for reusable product-card modules for monthly promotions.
output_examples.output: The response defines module width, image ratio, title length, price formatting, CTA rules, and fallback behavior. It also lists QA checks for long names and missing images.

output_examples.input: A developer shares a React Email concept for pre-launch review.
output_examples.output: The review separates rendering defects from brand preferences. It flags Outlook table risk, Gmail clipping risk, missing alt text, and unclear mobile button spacing.

best_practices: Provide target clients, QA results, and production constraints before requesting fixes.
Test long names, missing images, dark mode, and image blocking during review.
Separate rendering defects, accessibility issues, and brand preferences in final recommendations.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on image-only messages for important content or CTAs.
Do not approve template changes without checking mobile collapse and dark-mode contrast.
Do not apply one-off module overrides without documenting future content limits.

faq.question: What type of email work does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports responsive email design, template critique, module planning, dark-mode QA, accessibility review, and design handoff.

faq.question: Can it review existing HTML or React Email components?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the source, screenshot, or component details so the skill can inspect layout and client risks.

faq.question: Does it perform live email sends?
faq.answer: No. The skill requires explicit approval before any live send, contact import, DNS change, or automation change.

faq.question: Can it replace inbox rendering tools?
faq.answer: No. It helps prepare and interpret QA, but real client testing is still required.

faq.question: Does it cover accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks alt text, contrast, link affordance, heading order where possible, and text-image balance.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Email marketers, designers, developers, and operations teams can use it before production review.
